profile.headline: Full-stack Software Engineer | .NET • GoLang • Angular | Building scalable, user-focused solutions
profile.summary:
Collaborative software developer with backend focus. Delivers high quality software independently and as a team lead.  

Comfortable working concurrently at different levels of the stack and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders across departments.

People say I’ve a patient and collegiate style. I’m diligent in my selection of tooling and languages to advance the business needs. I seek an environment where I can thrive professionally, while adding great value to an organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building, some fixing, and but mostly learning lots!

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Collaborated with data science team to deliver a production ready energy market offer platform, enabling the sale of energy from both solar panels and the battery energy storage system (BESS) into ERCOT.

company.name: Geronimo Power, formerly National Grid Renewables

positions.title: Senior Software Developer and Team Lead
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Led team of software engineers building battery management platform and performance driven rewrite of IoT backend services.

Introduced SCRUM, feature branches and code reviews, resulting in less rework and fewer shipped field defects. Championed tooling and languages to improve safety and ease collaboration down the stack (GraphQL, GoLang, Protobuffers, ZMQ).

Recruited and mentored junior developers. Reduced developer onboarding time, increased build consistency by migrating full stack and embedded environments to Docker containers (and dev Containers).

Key projects included:

- Led migration of ARM IoT device to GoLang (GraphQL, Protobuffers, ZMQ, Angular)

 - Architected, and led ongoing support for device management software (NodeJS, TypeScript, ExtJS, PostgreSQL)

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Scoped, built and shipped web and desktop solutions. Often multi-lingual, managed literature translation from contractors.

Introduced ticketing system and version control, hired QA engineer, and introduced automated testing. Moved into informal leadership role by setting software requirements for team of engineers.

Projects included:

- Global partner quoting platform (AngularJS, PHP, to MySQL), supporting hierarchical login, reporting, scheduled price book changes.

- Migrate flagship Win32 GUI application into threaded, unicode, Windows client / service with embedded SQLite database.

- Angular JS energy dashboard tracking power cycles to REST API in Win32 BMS appliance.

- C# .NET based e-mail alert software (Windows service)

- Hardware simulator to allow full exercise of all software projects across the company (Delphi, Turbo Pascal)

- SNMP Agent (on TCP/UDP stack, Turbo Pascal) to add functionality to BMS product.
